name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: Steps as chapter marks: done steps get a brush check, the current one is an ink flat that sweeps in, the next ones are paper squares; the rail between done steps runs with speed lines. Horizontal or vertical; follows the manga reading order.

meta.tagline: Chapter marks for a multi-step flow.
meta.usage:
import { Stepper } from "@/components/manga/stepper"

<Stepper current={1} steps={[{ label: "Account" }, { label: "Shelf" }, { label: "Done" }]} />
